To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ANN based technique can be used as a pipeline to segregate stars from the galaxies in the UV region using the band integrated features.

ANN can be used to classify stars from galaxies using the limited band data and also that the ANN based classification using the full spectral data is more accurate than that based on the limited band data.

ANN based classification scheme using band integrated features can segregate the stars and galaxies in UV region with a classification accuracy of 90.6% and 93.3% using the band integrated data and full spectral data, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a pipeline for automated star-galaxy separation using ANN based technique.
developing a pipeline for automated separation of stars from galaxies using ANN based technique using band integrated data.
the development of a pipeline that can be used for automated classification of the TAUVIX/ASTROSAT data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the ANN based technique using band integrated data can be used to develop a TAUVEX data pipeline to segregate the stars and galaxies in UV region.
the ANN based technique can be used for the TAUVEX/ ASTROSAT satellite data processing and the results are promising.

the ANN-based technique can be effectively used for automated segregation of galaxies from the stars for TAUVEX and ASTROSAT satellite observations, and that the technique can be used for any future space mission in the UV band.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a pipeline to segregate stars from the galaxies using the band integrated features and full spectral features for TAUVEX and ASTROSAT data analysis.
, in order to segregate the stars from the galaxies, we need to use the full spectral features, which would be possible in the ASTROSAT case.
, the ANN based classification scheme using band integrated fluxes can be used for automated segregation of the stars from the galaxies for TAUVEX and ASTROSAT satellite observations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ANN based classification scheme can be used for TAUVEX and ASTROSAT missions.
the ANN technique, with a judiciously selected training set, can be used as a tool in the TAUVEX/ ASTROSAT pipeline to segregate the stars from the galaxies in a robust manner.
the ANN based technique can be used to classify the TAUVEX and ASTROSAT UV data.
